name: Isaac Alfasi
role: Maghrebi Talmudist and posek, commonly referred to as "the Rif"
contribution: A North African Maghrebi Talmudist, posek and codifier of Jewish law.

checks.lead: Isaac ben Jacob Alfasi (1013–1103) (Arabic: إسحاق الفاسي; Hebrew: ר׳ יצחק אלפסי), also known as Alfasi and by the Hebrew acronym Rif (Hebrew: רי״ף; Rabbi Isaac al-Fasi), was a North African Maghrebi Talmudist, posek (decider in matters of Halakha) and codifier of Jewish law. He is best known for his Sefer ha-Halakhot ("Book of the Commandments"), regarded as the first fundamental work of halakhic literature and the best-known code of Jewish law before Maimonides' Mishneh Torah ("Second Law Code").
